For this model, we will use two basics training and testing datasets:

* `prediction_dataset.csv`: For prediction purposes

* `regression_dataset.csv`: For training and regression purposes

### Load dataset
```{r}
# Regression Dataset
regression_data = read.csv("data/training_data/regression_dataset.csv")

regression_data$population = regression_data$population * 1000

# Prediction Dataset
prediction_data = read.csv("data/training_data/prediction_dataset.csv")

# Constrained Dataset
constrained_data = read.csv("data/_vnm_indicators/vnm_level0_gdp.csv")

```


### Preliminaries
Supposed:

* \(y \in \mathbb{R}^n\): observed outcome vector. That is, `grdp_per_capita`.
* \(X \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times p}\):esign matrix of explanatory variables. That is, `mean_radiance`, `population`, `pixel_count` (equivalently, `total_area`), `year`.
* \(\beta \in \mathbb{R}^p\): regression coefficients.
* \(a \in \mathbb{R}\): specified total prediction.

Here, \(X\beta\) is the vector of predictions, and the constraint ensures that their sum is exactly \(a\).

Define \(c=X^\top\mathbf{1}_n\). The constraint can then be written as
\[
c^\top\beta=a.
\]

```{r}
# Definitions
y <- regression_data$grdp_per_capita

X <- model.matrix(
  ~ mean_radiance + population + pixel_count + year,
  data = regression_data
)

n <- nrow(X)

p <- ncol(X)

year <- regression_data$year
years <- sort(unique(year))

population <- regression_data$population
```

### Optimization problem

The optimization problem is

\[
\boxed{ 
\begin{aligned} \min_{\beta}\quad & \|y-X\beta\|_2^2\\ 
\text{s.t.}\quad & \mathbf{1}_n^\top X\beta=a \end{aligned} 
}
\]
vince, so the yearly constraint is:
\[
\boxed{
\begin{aligned}
\min_{\beta}\quad & \|y-X\beta\|_2^2\\
\text{s.t.}\quad
&\sum_{i:\,\mathrm{year}_i=t}
P_iX_i\beta=a_t,
\quad t=2020,\ldots,2025
\end{aligned}
}
\]


```{r}
# Define optimization variable
beta <- Variable(p)

# Define fitted values
y_hat <- X %*% beta

# Define constrained
constraints <- lapply(years, function(t) {
  idx <- which(year == t)
  target_gdp <- constrained_data$gdp[constrained_data$year == t]

  sum_entries(population[idx] * y_hat[idx]) == target_gdp
})

# Define constrained least-squares problem
problem <- Problem(
  Minimize(sum_squares(y - y_hat)),
  constraints
)

# Solve
result <- solve(
  problem,
  solver = "CLARABEL",
  verbose = TRUE
)

print(result$status)

if (result$status %in% c("optimal", "optimal_inaccurate")) {
  beta_hat <- result$getValue(beta)
  predictions <- as.vector(X_matrix %*% beta_hat)

  yearly_check <- data.frame(
    year = years,
    predicted_total_grdp = sapply(years, function(t) {
      idx <- which(year == t)
      sum(population[idx] * predictions[idx])
    }),
    target_total_grdp = annual_grdp_vector[as.character(years)]
  )

  yearly_check$difference <-
    yearly_check$predicted_total_grdp -
    yearly_check$target_total_grdp

  print(beta_hat)
  print(yearly_check)
}

```
